preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and the maximum possible number of edges in a graph with n nodes, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range of node IDs.

preconditions.expression: The graph is connected and each vertex belongs to at most one simple cycle.
preconditions.description: The graph is guaranteed to be connected and each vertex will be part of at most one cycle.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of n integers
postconditions.description: The output is a list of n integers, where the i-th integer represents the maximum distance between node i and a leaf in the resulting tree if the removed edges were chosen in a way that minimizes this distance.
